insertions.before:
expected_git_sha:
        type: string
        required: false
        description: Exact approved commit; required for prepare-image only

- name: Require exact approved image revision before checkout
        if: inputs.operation == 'prepare-image'
        env:
          EXPECTED_GIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_git_sha }}
          LC_ALL: C
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$EXPECTED_GIT_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$EXPECTED_GIT_SHA" = "$GITHUB_SHA"

- name: Verify checked-out image revision before tooling and cloud authentication
        if: inputs.operation == 'prepare-image'
        env:
          EXPECTED_GIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_git_sha }}
          LC_ALL: C
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$EXPECTED_GIT_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$EXPECTED_GIT_SHA" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_GIT_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)"
